familia.preview_text: Preview: this site isn't published yet
familia.soon_title: We're getting family trips across Peru ready
familia.soon_text: Soon you'll be able to pick tours designed for traveling with kids. Meanwhile, our team is ready to help on our main site.
familia.hero_title: Explore Peru with your kids, at their pace
familia.hero_text: Tours made for families: flexible schedules, time to rest and guides who know how to tell Peru's story to little ones.
familia.hero_illustration: Illustration: a window with mountains, a smiling sun and colorful balloons
familia.tours_title: Tours to enjoy as a family
familia.tours_text: Each tour shows the ages it works best for, so you can choose without guessing.
familia.tours_empty_title: We're preparing our first family tours
familia.tours_empty_text: In the meantime, tell us who's traveling and we'll put together an itinerary that fits your kids.
familia.why_text: We know a good trip with kids comes down to the details. We take care of them.
familia.why_1_text: Licensed transport, trusted providers and support throughout your trip.
familia.why_2_text: Itineraries with time to eat, rest and acclimatize without rushing.
familia.why_3_text: Stories, games and questions that turn every visit into an adventure.
familia.why_4_text: Tickets, trains and transfers arranged so you can just enjoy.
familia.step_1_text: Check the recommended ages and length of each experience.
familia.step_2_text: Adults, kids and their ages: that's how we adjust prices, times and stops.
familia.step_3_text: Pay online or by link and get everything you need for the trip.
familia.cta_text: Send us your dates and your kids' ages. We'll reply with options within minutes.
familia.cta_whatsapp_message: Hi, we're traveling as a family and would like info about tours
familia.about_title: We plan trips the way we'd plan them for our own
familia.about_intro: Like In House is a Peruvian agency founded in 2018. Like In House Family brings together what we've learned welcoming families to Cusco, Machu Picchu and the rest of Peru.
familia.about_story_title: Traveling with kids changes the trip
familia.about_story_1: Schedules shift, hunger shows up suddenly and altitude feels different. That's why we design every family tour with room to spare: extra time, comfortable stops and backup plans if someone needs a break.
familia.about_story_2: Our guides tell Peru's story with questions, games and legends, so kids live it and parents enjoy it too.
familia.about_values_title: What we look after on every trip
familia.about_value_1_text: We're with you before, during and after the trip, on whichever channel you prefer.
familia.about_value_2_text: Clear prices for adults and kids, and conditions explained plainly.
familia.about_value_3_text: We work with local communities and providers, and follow the ESNNA child-protection code.
familia.faq_page_text: If your question isn't here, message us and we'll reply within minutes.
familia.faq_general_note: We don't have family-specific questions yet. These are the ones every traveler asks.
familia.contact_title: Let's talk about your family trip
familia.contact_text: Tell us your dates, destinations and the kids' ages. With that we'll send you a tailored proposal.
familia.contact_form_text: Mention how many kids are traveling and their ages in the comment.
familia.contact_whatsapp_text: We answer questions and confirm availability right away.
familia.contact_hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
familia.footer_text: Trips across Peru designed for families with kids, by Like In House.

familia.error_text: Try again in a few seconds. If it keeps happening, message us on WhatsApp.
